name: quartile
description: Write at Q1. Keep every number. Manuscript checks for business and economics research: hallucination guard, desk-rejection screen, statistics recomputation, references and journal bank.
long_description: Quartile checks academic manuscripts without changing their science. verify_rewrite blocks any revision that adds or changes numbers, citations, protected constructs, names or causal claims. check_statistics recomputes p-values from reported t, F, r, chi-square and z, and checks coefficient/SE against reported t, p and significance stars. analyze_manuscript and desk_screen run the five usual desk-rejection checks. Results appear as an interactive Quartile card. All checks run locally on your computer; nothing is sent anywhere. The optional full-text corpus (a private folder, for example in Google Drive) lets Quartile learn section-level patterns from up to 500 open-access Q1 papers; it is used for patterns only and every inspired rewrite is checked for copied wording.

tools.name: q1_style_guide
tools.description: Q1-Q4 writing, argument and framing standard

tools.name: check_statistics
tools.description: Recompute p-values and check regression tables

tools.name: check_references
tools.description: Cross-check citations and the reference list

tools.name: apply_replacements
tools.description: Apply only edits that pass the guard

tools.name: journal_lookup
tools.description: Journal quartile, SJR and difficulty from your bank

tools.name: journal_suggest
tools.description: Suggest journals by topic, quartile and difficulty

tools.name: compare_style
tools.description: Compare the abstract with the 501-abstract Q1 profile

tools.name: corpus_status
tools.description: Status of your private full-text corpus

tools.name: corpus_build
tools.description: Download and measure up to 500 open-access Q1 papers

tools.name: corpus_analyse
tools.description: Re-measure every paper in the corpus folder

tools.name: corpus_compare
tools.description: Compare a manuscript section by section with the corpus

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: Find the closest corpus papers and passages

tools.name: corpus_originality
tools.description: Flag sentences that copy 8+ words from the corpus

tools.name: integrity_screen
tools.description: COPE-aligned plagiarism and text-recycling screen before submission

prompts.name: q1_edit
prompts.description: Edit to the Q1 standard with the guard
prompts.text: Edit my manuscript to the ${arguments.tier} standard at the ${arguments.level} level. Call q1_style_guide first and verify_rewrite after every revised paragraph.

prompts.name: journal_editor
prompts.description: Act as a named journal's editor and three reviewers
prompts.text: Act as the handling editor of ${arguments.journal} and three reviewers. Call journal_lookup, analyze_manuscript and check_statistics first.

prompts.name: idea_to_paper
prompts.description: Frame a research idea as a tier-level paper
prompts.text: Frame my research idea as a ${arguments.tier} paper. Call q1_style_guide first. Never invent literature or results.

journal_bank.title: Journal bank (optional)
journal_bank.description: bank.json built from your SCImago export with scripts/build-bank.js. Leave empty if you have none.

corpus_folder.title: Corpus folder (optional)
corpus_folder.description: A private folder for the full-text Q1 corpus, for example a folder inside your Google Drive (Google Drive for desktop). Quartile downloads open-access papers here and measures them. Texts never leave this folder.
